translation: As pastagens ⟨do⟩ deserto ⟨se⟩ regam ⟨com orvalho⟩, ⟨e⟩ as colinas ⟨estão⟩ cingidas ⟨de⟩ júbilo ⟨para⟩ cantar.

tokens.rationale: Verb רעף (drip/irrigate) used metaphorically for watering pastures; in Portuguese requires auxiliary verbs
From נוה (habitation), here meaning 'pastures' or 'moradas' where cattle graze
Can mean both 'wilderness/pasture' and 'desert'; here likely 'wilderness pastures' according to context
Feminine plural of גיל (joy/rejoicing) metaphorically 'girded' on hills; requires pronouns and verb in Portuguese
Verb חגר (gird/clothe) + final nun emphatic; implies 'girded for celebration/singing' - requires auxiliary in Portuguese
